# Security

Security fixes target the latest `main` branch. Older snapshots have no separate support commitment. Reports and fixes are best effort, with no response deadline.

Do not put credentials, private paths, memory contents, live transcripts or exploit details in public issues. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting form on the Security tab only when it is enabled for this repository. If that option is unavailable, use an issue only to ask the maintainer for a private contact route, without vulnerability details. Share sensitive details only after a private route has been established.

Optional configuration tools can change local agent settings, hooks, permissions and memory placement. Review the selected tool and try its documented disposable workflow first. Native permissions and pattern guards have different limits; neither guarantees model behavior. See the README effects notice and adoption guidance.
